reuse.why: All six month-wide actions share category eligibility, while the change reuses existing tag parsing, spreadsheet access, budget writes, batching, and undo wrappers.

duplication.why: Repeated category queries and eligibility checks are consolidated into getMonthActionCategories without introducing duplicated decision blocks.

placement.why: Category eligibility and spending calculations remain in budget/actions.ts, with method registration and undo integration in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The diff is limited to the requested month-wide actions, their shared selection policy, method registration, and related tests.

maintainability.why: A single documented selector owns the exclusions and exposes only the requested hidden-category variation through a shared argument type.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions call getMonthActionCategories, and fixed-group detection uses extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: Eligibility logic is genuinely shared; copyPreviousMonth's ID membership check consumes the selector's result rather than reimplementing its rules.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and one conditional hidden-filter branch; this bounded extension serves every month-wide consumer.
